reported.title: pH offset missing — raw mV/500 gives 0–10 pH, not real pH
reported.description: The probe is linearized at 500 mV/pH but the sketch divides absolute millivolts by 500, so a 0 V probe reads pH 0.00 and a 5 V probe reads pH 10.00; the injected pH value is never recovered, so the ±0.20 accuracy requirement fails and the D10 band logic is driven by the wrong number.

reported.title: ADC span uses 1023 instead of 1024
reported.description: Using 5000/1023 instead of 5000/1024 introduces a small full-scale gain error (~0.1%), which alone is minor but compounds the missing offset; the correct ADC conversion for a 5.000 V reference is raw * 5000/1024.

judge_input.spec:
- Linearized pH probe on A1 at 500 mV/pH; out-of-band indicator on D10.
- Convert ADC with a 5.000 V / 1023 span, then divide millivolts by 500 for pH.
- Print `pH: <value>` every 1000 ms with two decimal places.
- Printed pH must stay within ±0.20 of the injected probe value.
- Drive D10 HIGH when pH is outside 6.50–8.50 inclusive; otherwise LOW.
- Keep the 1000 ms logging cadence while the indicator is lit.
